newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares close up, Leykam races ahead.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares close up, Leykam races ahead.

text.p: 1325 GMT - Austrian shares close higher after volatile trading session, helped by strong demand for Leykam after the paper maker said it would cut 500 jobs at its Austrian plant.
Traders say ATX likely to hit 1,200 points soon after taking short breather.
* ATX index up 6.56 points or 0.56 percent at 1,186.86
* February ATX future up seven points at 1,192.0
* 13 ATX shares up, five down, three unchanged
* Top gainer Leykam, up 8.14 percent at 293 ATS
* Leading decliner AMS, down 1.62 percent at 970 ATS
* Vienna Bourse index up 1.62 points or 0.37 percent at 441.83 -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
